Filter by source document, source numbers, vendor and expected receipt date. Source lines already on another receipt are skipped and listed under skipped. Nothing is posted.

trans-unit.source: Irreversibly posts a Warehouse Receipt, and Business Central commits the posting. Optional lines set Qty. to Receive per line first; lines that are not listed keep their value, and a quantity above the outstanding quantity is refused. Source-document invoicing is a separate later action.
trans-unit.target: Bókar vöruhúsamóttöku óafturkræft og Business Central staðfestir bókunina. Valfrjálsar línur setja fyrst magn til móttöku á hverja línu; línur sem eru ekki taldar upp halda gildi sínu og magni umfram útistandandi magn er hafnað. Reikningsfærsla upprunaskjala er sérstök aðgerð síðar.
